steps.label: Set JellySelfOverlap preset (a normal JellyDrop cube plus two extra marker particles appended 0.001 apart and connected to nothing -- the exact setup SelfCollisionTest.XPBDSolver_SelfCollisionEnabled_PreventsOverlap already validates at the unit level, see SoftBodyWorld::applyPreset())
Baseline: self-collision disabled (the preset's default -- see SoftBodyWorld::applyPreset())
Both markers fall together under identical gravity/floor/damping (~1s) -- nothing but self-collision could change their mutual separation
Minimum distance between non-edge-connected particles, uncorrected -- the two markers were never pushed apart, so this stays near their 0.001 starting gap
Rebuild the same scene from scratch
Same fall, same duration, self-collision now resolving the 0.001 initial overlap (~1s)
Change: with self-collision on, the two markers are kept measurably farther apart than the uncorrected baseline
